ShortDescription.Value: An in-game journal and planner for your city. A City Manager (Claude) writes your plans between sessions; you build them.

Publish.LongDescription:
# City Manager
You build the city. The City Manager keeps the plans and keeps you on track.
City Manager is an in-game journal for your city, kept by a City Manager: Claude, Anthropic's AI, in Claude Code on your own computer. Before you load your city, it writes the plan. Afterwards, it reviews what you built and writes the next one. No AI runs alongside the game.
## Features
- A journal panel (Ctrl+J or the cones button) with Today, Projects, Notes, Wrap-up and City tabs - Tonight's checklist, with unfinished tasks carried over - Projects of any size, with steps to tick and *Show on map* - Notes pinned to where you're looking, answered by the City Manager - A short wrap-up, plus what changed since you loaded the city - Plans drawn over your city with City Planning Draft: numbered steps, with the exact road pieces to use - A snapshot of your city for the City Manager: roads, buildings, budget, demand, services, problems and transit - With the Claude Code plugin: a founding chat for a new city, and a first road plan drawn from a survey of its map - Works on its own as a notebook, without Claude
## How to use it
1. Subscribe. City Planning Draft, the build overlay, comes with it. 2. Install the plugin. In the Claude desktop app's Code tab: **Plugins → Add → Add marketplace → Add from a repository**, paste https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager, press **Sync**, then install it. In Claude Code in a terminal: **/plugin install city-manager --marketplace mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager** 3. **Required first, in the game:** make a new city or load yours, press **Ctrl+J** and *Start a new journal for this city*, then press **Take a snapshot** on the journal's City tab. Save, and go back to the main menu. The City Manager reads your city from that snapshot: without a journal and a snapshot it has nothing to read. 4. Type **/city-manager:city-manager**. Your City Manager asks whether you're continuing a city or starting a new one, and takes it from there: a new city gets a charter, its first roads and planner drafts; a city you have gets a tour, a plan for what's next, and your unfinished plans as projects. 5. After that, the same command before and after each session: before, it writes tonight's plan (in the game: **Ctrl+J**, the Today tab); after you press *Done for today* and save, it reviews what you built and writes the next one. Claude stays closed while you play.
Without Claude, it's still a notebook: press **Ctrl+J** in any city and start a journal.
## Please read
- **Made with AI, with limited human review.** I'm not a coder. Claude wrote the code, working closely with me, and no experienced programmer has reviewed it. Reviews are welcome. - **Privacy.** The mod never goes online and sends nothing to me. When you use Claude, your journal and city snapshot go to Anthropic under your own Claude account. The full security report is on GitHub. - **Claude Code needs a paid Claude plan.** Without it, City Manager is still a notebook. - **Beta.** Played on Linux; no Windows player has tested it yet. English only. - **Made for my own games.** I keep improving it as I play, and I'm sharing it in case it's useful to you too.
How to use it, step by step: https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager/blob/main/docs/guide.md GitHub (code, setup, security report): https://github.com/mayorgergich/cs2-city-manager Discord: https://discord.gg/Rtea83Gnb9
